text:
tasha: Hey infra, CI is red on master — ci/inference-quant-e2e failing since last deploy. Can someone bisect? https://ci.redwood.example/ci/12345

dev-ci-bot: [CI] Job ci/inference-quant-e2e failed on master (build 12345). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/ci/12345/logs

ben: I can take a look. Quick question — anyone know the last-green commit?

liam: last-green was commit abcdef12 (merged ~2h ago). That PR bumped the Docker base to nvidia/cuda:12.1 and bumped some system libs.

tasha: sounds plausible. @ben if you can bisect that'd be great. If it's the base image bump we should revert fast. :warning:

ben: starting a quick local bisect. Running: `git bisect start --bad HEAD --good abcdef12` then `git bisect run ./scripts/run_quant_tests.sh`

ben: quick update — bisect pointed at commit 9f3b2d7 (PR #789) by ryan. The change is exactly the Docker base image -> `nvidia/cuda:12.1` and some packaging tweaks.

ryan: I merged that to get newer CUDA drivers for perf runs. Didn't hit this on my staging images, sorry all.

liam: repro steps I used locally: `docker run --gpus all --rm -v $PWD:/app nvidia/cuda:12.1 /bin/bash -c "cd /app && ./scripts/run_quant_smoke.sh"` — segfault during model kv cache init.

ben: reran tests with the previous base (`nvidia/cuda:11.8`) — tests pass. Narrowed it to libc/ld changes in 12.1 image.

ryan: I can open an immediate revert PR if that's the consensus.

tasha: please do the revert PR and mark it as emergency. We'll cut a hotfix and then reintroduce the image bump after staging validation.

ben: opened PR 790 — revert of 9f3b2d7. Tested the branch in CI, all quant jobs passed on the revert branch. https://ci.redwood.example/ci/12347

dev-ci-bot: [CI] Rerun requested by @ben for build 12347.

liam: also adding a tiny pre-e2e smoke that runs a container and loads a model before the full suite — to catch runtime image incompatibilities earlier.

ryan: will review and merge 790 now. Sorry for the churn. I'll add notes about the driver/runtime interplay to the PR description.

tasha: once 790 is merged, trigger canary rollback and hold the Docker update until we test on staging. Also add a short RCA in #postmortems. :thumbsup:

ben: confirmed — revert merged, canary rollback triggered, and quant e2e back to green. I'll follow up with a small test addition in a separate PR.

liam: note for next time: vendor libc bumps in base images need a runtime smoke in CI (separate job).

ryan: agreed. I'll schedule a follow-up to re-attempt the image bump behind a staged rollout.

tasha: thanks everyone. Closing the bisect and revert loop.
